product_launches.description: ComplyAdvantage and Sutherland introduced a unified AI-driven FinCrime management solution based on ComplyAdvantage's Mesh platform to help financial institutions combat sophisticated fraud and AML threats.

press_references.value: ComplyAdvantage Launches AI-Native Platform to Combat Surging Financial Crime

product_launches.description: ComplyAdvantage launched Mesh, an AI-native financial crime risk platform that unifies screening, customer risk scoring, transaction monitoring, and real-time payments analysis with agentic AI (Cassie) to cut false positives and speed investigations.

press_references.value: Democratising Access To Financial Crime Prevention Tools: ComplyAdvantage Launches New Platform

product_launches.description: ComplyAdvantage launched a new e-commerce platform that lets regulated SMEs directly access KYC, sanctions/PEP, adverse media screening, and ongoing transaction/payment monitoring with real-time data, providing enterprise-grade compliance tools within one business day.

overview_description.description: ComplyAdvantage offers AI-driven financial crime risk data and detection technology. ComplyAdvantage’s aim is to neutralize the risk of money laundering, terrorist financing, corruption, and other financial crime. More than 500 enterprises in 75 countries rely on ComplyAdvantage to understand the risk of who they’re doing business with through the world's only global, real-time database of people and companies. The company actively identifies tens of thousands of risk events from millions of structured and unstructured data points every single day.

about_short_description.short_description: ComplyAdvantage is an AI-based fraud and anti-money laundering risk detection platform for banks, insurance, and cryptocurrency industries.

product.name: ComplyAdvantage Mesh
product.description: A cloud-based financial crime risk platform for managing AML and fraud controls across customer onboarding, monitoring, transaction review, and investigations.

product.name: Financial Crime Risk Intelligence
product.description: Proprietary risk intelligence used to identify sanctions, politically exposed persons, relatives and close associates, and adverse media risks.

product.name: Customer Screening
product.description: AML screening software that checks individuals against sanctions, watchlists, PEP, RCA, and adverse media data during customer onboarding and review.

product.name: Transaction Monitoring
product.description: Software that analyzes financial transactions for suspicious patterns and generates alerts for compliance and fraud investigations.

product.name: Payment Screening
product.description: Real-time payment screening software that checks payment parties and payment data against sanctions and other financial crime risk intelligence.

product.name: Ongoing Monitoring
product.description: Continuous monitoring that identifies changes in customer risk profiles, including new sanctions, PEP, RCA, or adverse media information.
